name: ranged_open_fire
about: Ranged attack from the open. A hostile Troika gunman whose hint_groups admits no arena hint (FValidateHintType 0x10295c20 refuses on hint group AND m_iHintGroups == 0; the arena's nodes are group 1, the gunman's mask is group 2 only) sees the player in range. After SCHED_TROIKA_START_COMBAT 0xea (NEW_ENEMY), CNPC_VHumanCombatant's weapon split (0x103872d0) takes slot 605 CNPC_VHuman::SelectScheduleRangedCombat 0x10386560: no shoot-at hint, no 0x08/0x3c, the helpers answer 0 (the cover chooser finds no hint), and the split (neither 0x5f nor 0x08, not occluded, no 0x2e, not TOO_FAR) answers 0; CAI_BaseNPCTroika::SelectSchedule 0x102af660's combat ladder then takes CAN_RANGE_ATTACK1 (0x4f): 0x101e3f50, or RandomInt < 0x14 with no hint node and m_flEnemyDist < 800 -> 0xef SCHED_TROIKA_STEP_BACK_RANGE_ATTACK1, else 0xed SCHED_TROIKA_RANGE_ATTACK1 (cai_basenpctroika/sched_troika_range_attack1.sch: SET_FAIL_SCHEDULE IGNORE_FAILURE, STOP_MOVING, RESOLVE_BOTCH, FACE_ENEMY, ANNOUNCE_ATTACK 1, TASK_RANGE_ATTACK1, WAIT_FINISH_SET 0.0, WAIT_FINISH_ADD_RANDOM 1.0, RESOLVE_BOTCH, WAIT_ATTACK_TIME1). TASK_RANGE_ATTACK1 plays the weapon's attack activity and its anim event fires the shot (HandleAnimEvent 0x10274e30 through DispatchAnimEvents 0x10091880); the task completes on IsActivityFinished; TASK_WAIT_ATTACK_TIME1 (StartTask 0x102a337d: m_flWaitFinished = the weapon's next-attack stamp 0x10252450 + 0x102c5730; complete only once that is <= curtime) holds until the weapon's next-attack time (item_w_thirtyeight.txt Attack_Rate .8 at range 0, NPC_Attack_Rate_Min/Max 1.0 / 2.5 at NPC_Attack_Rate_Base_Range 120, scaled up with range: ~387 units here), so it cannot complete before the shot + 0.8 s; the earliest shot is START_COMBAT's 0.2 + 0.0..0.2 s, hence no completion before 1.05 s. The player faces the gunman, so the gunman is inside the player's view cone and COND_BEHIND_ENEMY 0x57 is never set. The next selection fires again.
known_red: V4o lane O3 (the event shot): game red. Since V4a the 3031 is the kernel dispatcher's (trace: 0.500 'sequence smith_attack rate=1', 0.500 'animevent 3031' inside task_range_attack1, through slot 258 0x10098c80 -> 0x10091880 -> slot 259 0x10274e30 -> Weapon_HandleAnimEvent 0x1032e210) and reaches the weapon, but FElysiumWeapon::CommitFromAnimEvent finds no staged transaction and commits nothing: CWeaponRanged's operator 0x10238160 -> 0x10238320 -> ModeDispatch(1) 0x102383b0 -> Shot 0x102387b0 (which stages nothing beforehand and advances m_flNextPrimaryAttack +0x730) is not ported for an NPC, so the stamp stays at its draw-time value (0) and TASK_WAIT_ATTACK_TIME1 0x102a337d completes at once: taskdone task_wait_attack_time1 at t=1.00, before 1.05. V4b integrator, 2026-10-04: since the V4b wave the FIRST wait holds 1.0 -> 2.3 s and this record reports unexpected-pass, but every later TASK_WAIT_ATTACK_TIME1 still completes in its own think (2.8, 5.5, 6.0 ...): the stamp is still not written per shot, the record only pins the first wait. What moved the first one was not isolated (slot 389 now answers a real point to AimGun, and the gather draws slot 197 every pass); the red stays O3's until Shot 0x102387b0 writes +0x730
notes: Corrected by the V4a seam (J7, J6): `shot_event` matched any animevent; it is the attack clip's 3031 (smith_attack authors 3031 at cycle 0), through CWeaponRanged's operator 0x10238160 -> 0x10238320 -> ModeDispatch(1) 0x102383b0 -> slot 373 Shot 0x102387b0: no retail path fires a Troika human's shot without the event. The `never` damage on the player states that no shot lands before the event: the schema has no window that closes at a label, so it closes at 0.3 s, the earliest instant retail's first shot event can fall (START_COMBAT's TASK_WAIT_FACE_ENEMY 0.2 s, then a selection and the attack program's first think).
